content.comment_body: Good afternoon. Does anyone have an example of how to implement a scaling function using [product_name]?
I'm not sure I fully understand your question. Creating custom blocks isn't possible; only user-defined functions (UDFs) can be made. Could you clarify what you need this for?

Hello [user_name], I'm also having trouble following your request. Usually, an amplifier module is used for scaling purposes. If you can provide more details about your issue, it will be easier for us to assist you. Greetings [user_name] (translated with Google)

analysis.insight_summary: Users are unclear about the request related to creating a 'scale block' in [product_name], suggesting a lack of information or documentation about custom functionalities. There's some confusion regarding the extent of customization possible, with some users indicating only UDFs are supported while advising the use of amplifier modules for scaling tasks.
